entries.title: Original wedding recording
entries.scope: The retained wedding source provides scene context. It does not establish every off-frame event.

entries.title: Bag and seat-location record
entries.scope: A bag was recorded beneath the bus seat with its exterior tag intact. Location does not settle ownership.

entries.title: Catering invoice CAT-18
entries.source: Ngozi and the catering team's record
entries.scope: The unaltered copy records wedding catering work and an outstanding balance. It does not prove the whole bag sequence.

entries.title: Full private wedding source
entries.scope: The copy retains the helping action missing from the crop. Keep it private unless later use has the required consent.

entries.title: Service slip SR-18
entries.scope: The wedding record logs a 21:14 assistance request for Bisi at the caterers' room. Keep its timestamp and source for comparison; it does not alone establish the full bag sequence or ownership.

entries.title: Nneka's attributed account
entries.scope: Nneka describes protecting the receipt folder, boarding the bus, leaving the bag while helping Bisi, returning and leaving a message. Compare independent records; public use follows the saved boundary and later exact review. No name, image or voice permission is granted.

entries.title: Receipts and promises diary
entries.source: Recorded property custodian and witnessed folder inspection
entries.scope: The agreed copy retains page order, CAT-18 and repeated promises about PB-1. The original remains under recorded custody; later return does not erase the permitted copy.

entries.title: PB-1 issue-label discrepancy
entries.source: Diary promise line and recorded PB-1 inventory band
entries.scope: The diary calls PB-1 current issue while its fictional story-prop band says RETIRED ISSUE. It has no StreetCoin, payment or redemption value.

entries.title: NE-1 exact-text permission record
entries.scope: This receipt records approval of the exact NE-1 redacted words only. Public use still needs the same approved wording and current permission; no name, image, voice or extra quote is covered. Withdrawal must be respected.

notes.title: Nneka's initial message
notes.scope: Nneka said she left the bag while helping Bisi. This initial account needs comparison with timing, locations and later testimony; it is not the later corroborated account.

notes.title: Open Window follow-up
notes.scope: The checked portfolio earned a follow-up option. First presentation, practice and callback preserve the same opportunity. KC's later decision about leaving remains open; this note is not wedding evidence.

notes.title: Blue folder reference
notes.scope: CAT-18 links to a blue folder labelled Receipts and promises. The usher confirms this invited visit, not the wedding bag sequence. Inspect the folder later with the recorded property custodian; this lead is not the recovered diary.

notes.title: Community transport reservation
notes.source: Attendant's corrected queue and allocation sheet
notes.scope: The bus party retains a reservation for later community staging. It is a story transport prop, not wedding evidence, spendable currency or witness permission. The earlier recorded custody, source limits and consent remain unchanged.

states.disclosure_admitted: KC explained that the earlier crop omitted the helping action.
states.disclosure_open: The crop conversation is unresolved; a later follow-up remains available.
states.disclosure_none: No disclosure decision is recorded yet.
states.custody_ngozi_record: Temporary custody: Ngozi holds the intact bag with the source list.
states.custody_joint_record: Temporary custody: a joint witnessed record is in place.
states.custody_none: Temporary custody has not been recorded at the meeting yet.
states.pact_protect: Pact: protect people and verify privately first; public use still requires consent.
states.pact_public_case: Pact: build a verified public case with consent; no main mission or evidence is removed.
states.pact_none: The group's investigation pact has not been chosen yet.

accountScopes.private_only: Private notes only. Public work uses anonymised service records; no identifying quote, image, name or voice.
accountScopes.redacted_review: Redacted text may be prepared for later exact review. No public use before that review, no name/image/voice, and later withdrawal must be respected.
accountScopes.unknown: No public permission is recorded. Keep the account private and use anonymised records.

reviewScopes.private_records: Public testimony was not approved. Keep the account private; use anonymised service records. The diary and main route remain available.
reviewScopes.approve_ne1: NE-1 redacted written text only, using the same approved wording and current permission. No name/image/voice or extra quote. Editing requires review again; later withdrawal must be respected.
reviewScopes.unknown: No valid current exact-text approval is recorded. Keep the account private and use anonymised service records.
